Liiga game weeks

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_gameweeks.Rd

Number of game weeks of a season and tournament.

Usage

liiga_gameweeks(season = NULL, tournament = "runkosarja")

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Omitted = the season in progress.

tournament

Tournament: runkosarja (regular season), playoffs, playout, qualifications, valmistavat_ottelut (preseason) or chl (Champions Hockey League). Required by the API; defaults to runkosarja.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (3 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
seriecharacterTournament code, uppercase (RUNKOSARJA, PLAYOFFS, PRACTICE, ...); in /schedule the integer tournament id instead (see serieId and Divergence notes).
nb_weeksintegerNumber of game weeks.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/gameweeks

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(liiga_gameweeks(season = 2026))
#> ── Liiga game weeks Information from liiga.fi ──────── fastRhockey 1.0.0.9000 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-10-18 12:06:48 UTC
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   season serie      nb_weeks
#>    <int> <chr>         <int>
#> 1   2026 RUNKOSARJA       27
# }
